get.description: The agenda items overlapping [from, to) (ISO 8601 with their offset, or server time without one ; at most 62 days apart), earliest first, with their participants. A recurring item (`recurrence` set) is listed once per occurrence in the range, with the dates of that occurrence and its `occurrence` day, which names it to `update_agenda_item`. `workspaces` lists the ids to read, separated by commas : the current workspace when left out. `participants` (user ids, separated by commas) keeps the items one of them takes part in, plus those without participants. An agent only reads the workspace of its token

post.description: Adds an item to the agenda of `workspace` (the current workspace when left out). Dates are ISO 8601 with their offset, or server time without one ; `ends_at` is exclusive : an all-day item of one day ends at midnight the next day. Participants are members of that workspace. `color` (#rrggbb) replaces the color of the workspace, null keeps it. `recurrence` repeats the item from its dates : `frequency` daily, weekly, monthly or yearly, every `interval` periods (1 by default), on ISO `weekdays` for a weekly item (1 = Monday, the day it starts by default), until the day `until` included (forever when null). A monthly or yearly item skips the months without its day

422.description: A participant is not a member of the workspace, or an invalid field

put.description: Replaces the title, description, dates, link, color, participants and recurrence of an agenda item. It stays in its workspace. Without `occurrence`, the dates are those of the first occurrence. For a recurring item, `occurrence` (the day a listed occurrence gives) makes the dates those of that occurrence, and `scope` tells what changes : `occurrence` (the default) moves it out of its item, as an item of its own happening once ; `following` ends the item the day before and starts a new one ; `series` moves every occurrence as this one moves. The answer is the item holding the change
